releaseNotes.current.queue.detail: You can start several sends, retrievals or removals in a row. Your Lunii handles them one at a time and the list shows what is waiting.
releaseNotes.current.sound.title: Quiet sounds flagged
releaseNotes.current.sound.detail: When you add a sound that is nearly silent, completely silent or will need a big boost, an amber marker warns you right away.

releaseNotes.current.updates.detail: If you want, Story Studio tells you when a new version is out. It never installs anything on its own.
releaseNotes.current.episodes.title: New episodes
releaseNotes.current.episodes.detail: When a podcast or YouTube source you follow has a new episode, Story Studio tells you on every screen, catalogue included.
releaseNotes.open.label: What’s new
releaseNotes.current.fixes.label: If you unplug the Lunii during several sends, you get one complete summary. A project that was never exported can be sent from the catalogue, a silent sound no longer blocks generation, and Ctrl+F works in the catalogue. Plus various fixes and improvements.

flam.production.title: Build and install

flam.production.failure.InvalidDocument: Fix the adventure diagnostics before building.
flam.production.failure.InvalidPack: The pack content is invalid. Build it again.

flam.production.failure.AlreadyExists: This identity already exists at the destination. Replacement is not supported.

flam.production.failure.DeviceChanged: The library changed during transfer. Check its state before trying again.
flam.production.failure.RecoveryRequired: Recovery could not be confirmed. Keep the backups in Story Studio application data (flam-installations) and check the library before another transfer.
flam.production.failure.Busy: A FLAM operation is already running. Wait for it to finish.
flam.production.failure.Io: The operation failed. Check folder access and available space.
